methodologyNote: Measured via search host referrals in tracked traffic.
metricLabel: market share of tracked page views / usage
aiSummary: In October 2026, Google google.com led search engine hosts in Indonesia at 76.59% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Google scholar.google.co.id ranked second at 7.13%, followed by Google scholar.google.com at 6.35%.

faqs.question: Which item leads search engine hosts in Indonesia?
faqs.answer: Google google.com leads at 76.59% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/search-engine-host-market-share/indonesia.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for search engine hosts in Indonesia?
faqs.answer: Google google.com (76.59%), Google scholar.google.co.id (7.13%), Google scholar.google.com (6.35%) in October 2026.
